draft.editor_note: For the editor · not in the post

draft_panel.title: Telegram draft
draft_panel.select_first: Select the event first: “Take” → “Select”. Drafts can be edited only for selected events
draft_panel.back_to_draft: The event went back to editing and needs approval again
draft_panel.offline: Offline — changes are kept only in this browser
draft_panel.save_before_copy: Save before copying: the saved version is copied.

failure.generation_failed: Could not generate: the event has no sources.

draft_panel.brief_missing: Generate the AI brief in this language first (the “AI brief” block above)
draft_panel.ai_off: AI model is not connected — translation unavailable
draft_panel.save_before_translate: Save your edits first — the saved version is translated
draft_panel.already_in: The draft is already in this language
draft_panel.channel_target: After “Ready” this exact version goes to {channels}.
draft_panel.channel_off: (the channel's autoposting is off right now)

channel_blocked.language: Channel {channel} posts in “{channel_lang}”, but this post is in “{post_lang}”, so it will not go there. Translate it with the button above and approve again.
channel_blocked.filters: Channel {channel} will not take this event: it does not pass the channel filters (minimum importance, regions, sports or sources). Change the channel filters in “Autopost” or post it manually.
channel_blocked.too_old: Channel {channel} only takes fresh events (latest article within 3 days), and this one is older, so autoposting will not send it. Copy the post and publish it manually.

draft_panel.save_before_approve: Save your edits first — the saved version is approved
draft_panel.approve_blocked: No channel will take this version — see the reasons below

edit.title: Edit event
edit.updates_since_edit: New sources arrived after your edit.

create.title: New event
create.links_hint: One link per line, up to 10.
create.skipped: These links already belong to other events:

merge.title: Merge event
merge.locked: Ready or published events cannot be merged
merge.warning: The selected event “{title}” will be rejected as a duplicate and its {count} sources moved here.

move.reject_empty: The event has no sources left. Reject it?

brief.title: AI brief
brief.waiting: The AI is preparing the brief — usually under a minute. No need to reload.
brief.empty: No brief in this language yet.
brief.ai_unavailable: No AI model connected (AI_PROVIDER). Briefs are unavailable — use the original and the template draft.
brief.stale: New articles arrived after generation — the brief may be outdated. Rebuild it.

translated: Translated by AI — hover to see the original
same_language: The source writes in the interface language, no translation needed

post_format.title: Post format (all posts)
post_format.include_source_link: Original source link at the end
post_format.instructions: What to write (instructions for the AI)
post_format.instructions_placeholder: E.g. 3–4 sentences, end with what it means for betting
post_format.applies: Applies to all new posts. Existing posts stay as they are — press “Regenerate”.
post_format.auto_mode: AI writes the first version of each post (in the background, in turn)

rationale.not_sports: Not about sport: no sport, clubs or competitions found.
rationale.no_signals: No importance signal matched — low importance.

mod.priority_up: Level raised: top competition or club.
